mentions.name: Cosmic Peptides
mentions.description: An e-commerce peptide storefront built end to end with generative AI, launched 75 days from start to first order. Includes a custom Claude Code-built Shopify theme with collections, product pages, and legal pages, a COA database, AI-generated product imagery, label design and copy, and SEO product titles and descriptions.
mentions.source_excerpt: I wanted to see if I could use generative AI to build a whole business. Not just a digital product or an app — but the entire business from end to end
